style: Palette of cold slate blue and grey shadows with glowing mint green energy light and soft lilac alien glow.

images.prompt: Wide side-view shot of a vast dark underground cavern full of ruined alien machinery, huge pipes and broken metal walkways, faint glowing doorways far below. On a rock ledge on the right stands a small lone explorer in a bulky, rounded teal-and-cream armored powersuit with a dark visor helmet, holding a compact energy rifle, looking out over it. The lower left of the picture is dark open cavern.

Side-view action shot in a narrow dark metal corridor: a small lone explorer in a bulky, rounded teal-and-cream armored powersuit with a dark visor helmet, holding a compact energy rifle, fires a wide fan of glowing mint energy shots at a swarm of small purple flying alien bugs. Beside them, one wall panel is cracked and eroded with a faint glowing seam. Pipes and grating along the ceiling.

Wide side-view cross-section of a huge underground complex like a cutaway map: dozens of rectangular rooms stacked and linked by vertical shafts and long corridors, each room a different chamber of rock, machinery or alien growth, round doors glowing mint, lilac and amber between them. In one small room near the middle, a tiny explorer in a teal-and-cream powersuit.

Tall portrait cover in side view: at the bottom, a small lone explorer in a bulky, rounded teal-and-cream armored powersuit with a dark visor helmet, holding a compact energy rifle, stands alone on a jagged rock ledge looking up at an enormous dark facility built into a towering cliff, a few windows glowing mint and lilac, pipes and antennas on its roof. Stormy dark sky with lightning fills the top of the picture.

Extreme wide side view of a dark alien jungle at night: a research complex sunk into the cliffs and caves, its pipes, domes and lit windows half swallowed by giant roots and vines, cave mouths below leading deep underground, a heavy storm overhead with distant lightning.
